# Apache Answer connected authoring reduction

This fixture connects Apache Answer authentication, question query, runtime
detail, create/edit validation, administration, and logout shapes at
`3b9f1370612e690a0b7f230f05e688930db4c6d3` (Apache-2.0). A deterministic test
server remains authoritative; ordinary React-shaped state, effects, forms,
routes, and native document navigation use existing Kudzu semantics.
